title: Neetu Singh v. Executive Engineer, Vidyut Nagariya Vitaran Khand, Bamrauli
coram: Sanjay Yadav, C.J. and Prakash Padia, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; EE to decide pending 6.5 objection within 30 days.
headnote: Where a consumer has already invoked clause 6.5 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005 on a tariff-classification grievance, the High Court will not examine the merits in writ jurisdiction and will instead direct the Executive Engineer to decide the pending objection within a fixed time.
facts: Neetu Singh sought a writ of mandamus directing the Executive Engineer, Vidyut Nagariya Vitaran Khand, Bamrauli, Prayagraj, to treat her electric connection no. 6819396176 as covered under tariff LMV-9-(B)(i)(i) (metered individual residential construction). She had already invoked clause 6.5 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005 by a representation dated 10 February 2021, then pending with the same Executive Engineer. Counsel for the petitioner and for the distribution licensee were heard on video conferencing.

holding_units.topic: pending clause 6.5 objection as alternate remedy to a writ seeking tariff reclassification
holding_units.holding: Where the consumer has already invoked clause 6.5 of the Supply Code, 2005 by a representation pending before the Executive Engineer on a grievance seeking reclassification of a connection under LMV-9-(B)(i)(i), the High Court will not dwell on the merits in a writ petition and will dispose of the petition by directing that Executive Engineer to decide the pending objection expeditiously, not later than thirty days from communication of the order.

principle_tags.application: The petitioner's clause 6.5 representation dated 10.02.2021 was already pending with the Executive Engineer, so the Court remitted that objection for decision within thirty days instead of examining the LMV-9-(B)(i)(i) classification on merits.
Mandamus seeking tariff reclassification was disposed of without a merits decision because clause 6.5 of the Supply Code, 2005 already furnished the statutory route, which the petitioner had invoked.

not_decided.point: Whether connection no. 6819396176 is correctly classified under LMV-9-(B)(i)(i) (metered individual residential construction)
not_decided.note: Left for the Executive Engineer to decide on the pending clause 6.5 objection dated 10.02.2021.
